title: Isaiah 43
paragraphs: ¹ But now, this is what the LORD says — he who created you, Jacob, and who formed you, Israel: 'Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name; you are mine. ² When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; when you cross the rivers, they will not sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned; the flames will not set you ablaze. ³ For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt as your ransom, Cush and Seba in exchange for you. ⁴ Because you are precious in my eyes and honored, and because I love you, I will give people in exchange for you, nations in exchange for your life. ⁵ Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your children from the east and gather you from the west;

⁶ I will say to the north, Give up, and to the south, Do not hold them back. Bring my sons from far away and my daughters from the ends of the earth — ⁷ everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed and made.' ⁸ Bring out the people who have eyes but are blind, who have ears but are deaf. ⁹ Let all the nations gather together, let the peoples assemble. Which of their gods foretold this and announced it to us? Let them bring their witnesses to prove they were right, so others may hear and say, 'It is true.' ¹⁰ 'You are my witnesses,' declares the LORD, 'and my servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and trust me and understand that I am he. Before me no god was formed, nor will there be one after me.'

¹¹ 'I, even I, am the LORD, and apart from me there is no savior. ¹² I have revealed and saved and proclaimed; no foreign god was among you when I did it. You are my witnesses,' declares the LORD, 'that I am God. ¹³ Yes, and from ancient days I am he. No one can deliver out of my hand. When I act, who can reverse it?' ¹⁴ This is what the LORD says — your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: 'For your sake I will send forces against Babylon; I will bring down the Babylonians as fugitives, in the ships they took such pride in. ¹⁵ I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.'

¹⁶ This is what the LORD says — he who made a way through the sea, a path through the mighty waters, ¹⁷ who drew out chariots and horses, an army with all its strength; they lay down together and rose no more, extinguished, snuffed out like a wick: ¹⁸ 'Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. ¹⁹ See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up — do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the desert and streams in the wasteland. ²⁰ The wild animals honor me, the jackals and owls, because I provide water in the desert and streams in the wasteland, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

²¹ the people I formed for myself that they may proclaim my praise. ²² Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; you have grown weary of me, Israel. ²³ You have not brought me your sheep for burnt offerings; you have not honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with grain offerings or wearied you with demands for incense. ²⁴ You have not bought me fragrant calamus with your money, nor have you given me the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened me with your sins and wearied me with your wrongdoing. ²⁵ I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake, and I will remember your sins no more.'

²⁶ 'Put me in remembrance; let us argue the case together. Set out your case, and you may be proved right. ²⁷ Your first ancestor sinned; your teachers rebelled against me. ²⁸ So I disgraced the officials of the sanctuary, and delivered Jacob to destruction and Israel to ridicule.'
